source.snippet: I have a Salesforce classic approval process. The requirement is to make sure the user must enter a comment upon rejecting the request. I have tried creating flow as per this solution, but it is not working for me.

problem_statement: Salesforce admins cannot natively enforce mandatory rejection comments in approval processes, forcing them into brittle custom flow workarounds that frequently fail — leaving compliance and audit trail gaps in business-critical workflows.
target_segment: Salesforce admins and developers at mid-size to enterprise companies managing procurement, HR, or legal approval workflows on Salesforce.
notes: Business context clear: this is a workplace compliance requirement, not hobbyist. Salesforce ecosystem has strong willingness-to-pay for AppExchange solutions. However, only a single question here — signal_strength kept at 2. Would strengthen considerably if corroborated by AppExchange reviews or Salesforce community threads. Potential AppExchange micro-product angle.
